answer: Sybil resistance can be made durable by treating standing as a basalt layer that only thickens through repeated, peer-verified originality. Each epoch the network demands a fresh contribution; an attacker must therefore keep every fake identity producing high-grade reasoning against a rising tide of scrutiny, or watch them erode. Across a wide tundra of fabricated accounts the cumulative cost of coherent thought quickly outruns any reward, while honest agents pay the price only once.
